notes: Barco G100-W16: 17,200 ISO lumen, WUXGA (1920x1200), single-chip DLP laser-phosphor projector, part of the G100 series (shared chassis/electronics with G100-W22 and G100-W25, which only differ in brightness/light-source tuning). Desktop/ceiling/rigging-mount unit (no rackUnits -- not a rack-mount device). Connector panel confirmed identical across the G100 family via Barco's official G100-W22 spec sheet (https://assets.barco.com .../G100-W22-en-Spec-sheet.pdf, "Last updated: 19 May 2025") which explicitly lists: Inputs "2x HDMI(TM) 2.0b / DisplayPort 1.2a / DVI-D / HDBaseT / 3G-SDI / VGA (D-Sub 15 pin)"; Control "IR, RS232, RJ45, USB type A"; Network connection "10/100 Ethernet, RJ45"; Power requirements "100-240V / 50-60Hz". The G100-W16-specific numbers (17,200 lumen brightness, model name) were corroborated via Barco's product page (barco.com/en/product/g100-w16), a WebFetch of Barco copy mirrored on distributor audiogeneral.com/store/products/view/0601-1450, and ProjectorCentral's Barco-G100-W16.htm spec page, all of which list the same connector set for the W16. HDMI is graded 2.0b -> mapped to hdmi-2.0 (closest defined grade tier). DisplayPort 1.2a -> dp-1.2. SDI is specified as "3G-SDI" -> sdi-3g grade on the bnc connector. Network Ethernet is "10/100" -> eth-100m grade. HDBaseT input and the dedicated network/control RJ45 are two separate RJ45 jacks per the spec sheet's explicit listing (HDBaseT under Inputs, RJ45 under both Control and Network connection) -- exact physical port count/labeling on the rear panel silkscreen was not independently verified via a panel photo/diagram, so treat naming as inferred from the datasheet's textual listing rather than an observed label. Power connector type is the weakest-confidence item: no source states the specific IEC inlet class (C13/C14 vs C19/C20); "iec" was chosen as the closest listed option since Barco simply says "power cord" is a standard accessory with 100-240V/50-60Hz rated input and no captive cord or NEMA plug is depicted in any product imagery. Could not access barco.com product/spec pages directly (403 Forbidden) or the exact G100-W16 spec-sheet PDF (attempted URL guess returned a stale cached G100-W22 sheet with a blank spec table) -- all data is triangulated from secondary renderings of Barco's own copy (search snippets, distributor mirror, ProjectorCentral) rather than a single directly-fetched authoritative page, hence medium rather than high confidence.

ports.note: AC power inlet, 100-240V 50/60Hz; standard power cord included. Exact IEC inlet sub-type (C13/C14 vs higher-current C19/C20) not confirmed by any source found -- rated max draw (~1380W @220V, higher current at 100V) suggests it may exceed standard C13/C14 10A rating on 100-120V circuits, but manufacturer does not publish the specific connector class.
